title: Field-aware invert of a prior ExtractAudioClip command
aggregateCanonical: sha256 of sorted "digest  path\n" lines of sourceSha256
bounds: Field-aware invert of a prior non-tip ExtractAudioClip command restores only that command's extract write set (the new audio track and clip, the link group, and the host linkGroupId) when those fields still match the command's after-image. A later leave-gap move of an uninvolved remnant does not conflict: invert removes the extracted audio and link and keeps the moved remnants and already-followed cues.

A later linked move of the extracted host, a later mute of the new audio track, or invert of the tip, is whole-group UNDO_CONFLICT and does not roll the database back. Official InversePatch kind stays restoreSnapshot. Linear undo/redo stay tip snapshot restores. Invert's version indexer and bumper skip source refs (maps with streamId) so they cannot overwrite an asset or rewrite clip source.version. Video and caption mute/solo stay refused at admission with FEATURE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Audio muted/solo stay SetAudioTrackState. syncLock is not toggled. Already-delivered ExtractAudioClip, UnlinkAudioVideo / LinkAudioVideo, SetAudioTrackState, and SetTrackState locked/unlock semantics stay unchanged. A diverging unlink invert remains LINK_OFFSET_MISMATCH.

A real UI path splits, adds left and right cues, extracts persistent audio from the left remnant, commits a single-clip leave-gap move of the uninvolved right remnant, inverts the ExtractAudioClip command, then undoes, redoes, archives a fork, and exports a VTT sidecar. Preview and MP4 still refuse CAPTION_RENDER_POLICY_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. The single-clip Move button stays MoveClip.

Already-delivered extract, unlink/link, SetAudioTrackState, SetTrackState locked, caption-aware GroupClips/UngroupClips, invert of SetCaptions / SetMarkers / GroupClips / SetTrackState / SetAudioTrackState / UnlinkAudioVideo, insert-move leave-gap, overwrite, LiftClips/Cut, caption default/follow/interval/source-window, marker absolute default / clipLocal follow / ripple interval, 1000 seeded random undo, and the opened section-3 geometry matrix stay unchanged. Auto-close-on-move, new-track, cross-project bake, OS clipboard, source-interval crop, marker sidecar formats, a complete invert matrix, I-006, MP4 burn-in, and the table's 0.02s off-grid offset are not in this slice. Lifting a clipLocal-marker host remains REF_NOT_FOUND. An uncovering or cropping interval remains ANCHOR_OUT_OF_RANGE.
